7329.title: Pooled Claude catalog discovery depends on CLI initialization
7329.rootCauseOneLine: bb relies solely on CLI initialization models while pool routing isolates the host login; the upstream served-catalog authentication gate remains unverified.
7329.proposedFix: Capture an isolated authenticated catalog trace before designing pool-owned discovery that preserves host-login isolation.
7329.caveats: Two clean checkouts passed six model/memo tests and one pool environment test. This verifies bb-side boundary conditions, not the live authenticated omission or current model access. No fix PR: the authenticated symptom is not reproduced and the likely repair crosses catalog/authentication responsibilities. Tests and output are inline under site policy.
